items.title: Google language AI announcement: verify developer availability
items.summary: The technical radar links a Google language-AI announcement and discusses audio translation, transcription and local models. These names, dates and capabilities require primary-source verification; group the announcement as one story.
items.decision: Determine which capabilities developers can actually use now and which are announcements only.
items.example_idea: Inspect a verified public model configuration or calculate local memory requirements; do not claim measured translation quality.
items.availability: Unverified: check API documentation, model cards and access requirements.

items.title: Enterprise AI cost controls: from webinar to a reproducible budget example
items.summary: The technical radar cites a vendor webinar on enterprise cost controls. Treat it as educational material until actual product documentation and release dates are checked.
items.decision: Choose a measurable budget control and understand its limits.
items.example_idea: Compare per-user budget policies with fixed synthetic usage and explicit assumptions.
items.availability: Unverified; a webinar is not proof that a new capability shipped.
